completedActions.title: Implement exponential moving average (EMA) for synthesis time estimation
completedActions.description: Replaced elapsed-time-based estimation (vulnerable to cached segments) with EMA tracking. Added segmentSynthesisTime property tracking actual synthesis duration per segment. EMA uses smoothing factor α=0.3 to adapt to changing speeds. Estimation now calculated as: remaining_time = pending_segments_count × segmentSynthesisTime. Cached segments no longer distort baseline, and blank skips don't affect rate calculation. All 381 tests pass.

name: AudioSynthesisSession underestimates completion time for parttially cached suttas
summary: The estimate is affected by the negligible time taken to skip pre-cached segments.
